fusions.name: Parasite Pluck
fusions.desc: Picks every one of your afflictions off the target at once, dealing 16 damage plus their remaining damage, with 60% more damage for each affliction picked off. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Bitter Smear
fusions.desc: A quick weapon strike smeared with drawn venom that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Nit-Picking
fusions.desc: Picks up to 3 conditions off you and off every ally near you, and you regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Flicked Back
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be picked off and sent back to whoever inflicted it.
